items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: I played with him in Chicago. In Chicago? In Johnson Cabaret.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Well, did you ever play in any of those mansion houses in the district there, Alphonse? I played for Lula White. She had a band in there too, didn't you? Lula White. Lula White. Uh-huh. Lula White. I thought about pretty woman, can you show? Lula White. Yeah, look like I'm looking at her. Hey, you all making me think about anything else like that. Lula White. He was a piano player. He was what you call a piano player. Johnny Jackson? Oh, no. I played with him in Chicago. In…
Do you remember any of his tunes? Do you remember any of the tunes he played? No, I don't. I see. He could sing well, too, I think. But the piano player, he was one.
